At BODHi Montessori, the journey now continues from Primary (M1,M2,M3) into Lower Elementary (Grade 1,2,3).

As children grow beyond the primary years, their minds seek deeper understanding, exploration, and connection.

Through Montessori’s Cosmic Education, children investigate the world around them—asking questions, researching ideas, and discovering relationships between all things.

In our mixed-age Lower Elementary environment, independence, collaboration, and a lifelong love of learning continue to flourish.

Welcome to Lower Elementary at BODHi Montessori.

The mixed-age community is a cornerstone of Montessori. Children do not learn only from adults—they learn from one another.

The mixed-age community is one of the most purposeful aspects of Montessori education. Younger children are naturally inspired by what they observe around them, while older children deepen their own understanding by helping, guiding, and setting examples.

A child sees what is possible before being formally taught. They watch, absorb, imitate, practise, and eventually master skills at their own pace.

This creates a community built on respect rather than competition, collaboration rather than comparison.

The beauty of a mixed-age environment lies in its naturalness. Just as families and society are made up of people of different ages, Montessori classrooms bring children together in a way that nurtures independence, confidence, empathy, leadership, and a genuine love for learning.

Every child is learning.
Every child is contributing.
Every child belongs.

✨ The journey began with a question:

“Where are we in this space?” 🌌🔭

In Montessori Cosmic Education, we follow the child’s wonder and curiosity. As the children explored their location in the universe, their studies led them from the vastness of space to our own planet Earth. 

Through observation , discussion , and hands-on exploration , they deepened their understanding of Earth as a sphere and discovered what lies beneath its surface. By bisecting the Earth model, they explored its layers and learned about the Barysphere, the Earth’s core. 

Each discovery leads to another question, another connection, and another opportunity for understanding. 

The work continues, guided by curiosity  and a growing awareness of our place in the cosmos. 🌏
